propositions: The `--retry` flag must resume only the literal latest eligible INDETERMINATE review by reading discovery_journal from the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, classifying units as reusable (success/resumed) or retryable missing (failed/cancelled), and recomputing checkpoint_identity digests to validate material/policy/code/prompt/model/mode/topology/context/dependency/source integrity.

Reusable unit findings must be loaded via sizing.load_checkpoint and combined with results from re-running missing units and budget-shed units under a fresh per-invocation attempt budget, with pass-2 verification/coaching and deterministic decision/assembly rerunning over the combined set.

The retry must fail with exit code 2 before any model call if the latest result is ineligible, the journal is missing/legacy/corrupt/stale/digest-mismatched, or recomputed identity-digests no longer match present lineage; the error message must direct the operator to full-review remedy.
`--retry` must be mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; compatible with `--no-sign`; and leave normal review behavior unchanged without the flag.

Documentation must be added to canonical `review-plan --help`, `docs/cli-reference.md`, `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, and `docs/exit-codes.md` covering eligibility, fresh budget, reused blockers/successes, zero-call refusal, flag interactions, and signing behavior.

End-to-end CLI subprocess tests must prove the eligible resume path, zero-call refusal path, persisted retry lineage, and final exit/verdict semantics with real production journal codec and stateful fake at the model boundary.
